common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 一条白色吸水纸竖着放

Its lower tip dips into a shallow container of colored water

common_intent_requirements.text: 近拍颜色从接触处沿纸慢慢向上洇开
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 近拍颜色从接触处沿纸慢慢向上洇开
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: a static close shot frames a narrow strip of white absorbent paper held upright by a small clip at its upper end. Its lower tip dips into a shallow container of colored water, while the upper paper begins dry and white. Keep the liquid surface, contact point, and a readable length of paper visible together. Color first appears where the paper touches the water. A wet, tinted front then slowly spreads upward through the connected paper fibers, leaving a visible boundary between damp colored paper and the dry region above.

physics_checks.criterion: 染色或湿润前沿从纸与液体的接触处沿材料连续发展。
physics_checks.observable_evidence: 下部先湿润，上方连续出现染色扩展，仍可辨识干湿边界。
fail_examples: 未接触供液处先在上端凭空出现独立湿块
水离开纸纤维形成向上飞行的自由水柱
整条纸瞬间等量染色且没有扩展过程
not_required: 不要求特定上升高度或恒定速度
不要求杯中液面出现可见下降
不把毛细上升当作违反重力

evaluation_boundary: Assess only supplied requirements. Professional additions are not hidden requirements for ordinary input.
